# Remote Work

This policy sets out how and when staff can work away from the office.

## How much

Staff may work remotely up to three days a week. The remaining days are spent in the office, where teams agree on shared days so that people who need to collaborate are present at the same time. Teams that work closely with customers may agree stricter rules with their director. The policy is recorded under reference ASPEN-6.

## Where

Remote work is allowed from home or from another fixed place inside the country of your employment contract. Working from abroad for longer than two weeks a year needs approval from the people team, because it can have tax and insurance consequences.

## Equipment and costs

The company provides a laptop and, on request, a monitor and a chair for the home workspace. A monthly allowance covers part of the internet and electricity costs. Equipment remains company property and is returned when you leave.

## Availability

During remote days you are expected to be reachable during the core hours agreed with your team. Calendars should show where you are working so that colleagues can plan meetings.

## Exceptions

Temporary exceptions, for example during a house move or for medical reasons, can be agreed with your manager.
